key_statutory_notes: Texas does not impose an individual state income tax. A 1031 exchange can still defer eligible federal gain.
No Texas individual income-tax clawback is identified in this baseline. Texas franchise tax treatment requires separate entity-specific review.
Use a qualified intermediary before receiving sale proceeds; federal identification and completion deadlines generally remain 45 and 180 days.
rate_description: 0% individual state income tax; federal and entity-level taxes may still apply.
